newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse ends a shade firmer in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse ends a shade firmer in thin trade.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed mixed on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Monday as amendments in the trading rules went into effect, traders said.
The BUX index closed at 3,552.20 points, up 8.05.
BUX index futures ended firmer for the four nearest maturities, by 16.00 to 47.50 points and remained unchanged for the two longest maturities.
Spot share turnover totalled 610.5 million forints.
Technically the amended trading rules debuted smoothly despite a short delay in the start of the session, traders said.

However, some of the new rules require increased attention from traders who now have to pay attention to price movements of all shares whereas so far were accustomed to watch price movements of around 10 shares traded in one block.
"In the new trading system when all shares trade at the same time it's more difficult to pay attention," said Peter Nagy of Postabank Securities. "Traders need some time to get accustomed to it."
Traders picked out hotelier Danubius which rose to peak at a new life high of 3,000 forints amid continuous demand. Later it retreated to end at 2,950 forints, up 55.
Pharmaceuticals maker Human also rose to a new high of 2,340 forints, before it retreated to end at 2,300, up 105.
"In the past two or three weeks Human did not follow the two other pharmaceuticals so it's rise was reasonable," Nagy said.
